rulings: CF-THE-COMPETITION-IS-THE-PRODUCT (Drew, 2026-09-06): all 66 soccer league/competition keys are DISTINCT PRODUCTS, and a Prizm / Select / Chrome SOCCER release is ALWAYS a competition product. There is no bare '2022 Panini Prizm' soccer flagship. Every soccer row addressed hiq:soccer:2022:panini-prizm:* is therefore at a wrong address by construction, not by judgement.

COUNT BY SOURCE, AND THE SOURCE DECIDES THE SHAPE. Measured read-only 2026-09-06 against prod: 1,395 soccer rows at the bare address are sales-derived (ingest-auto-seed 995, ingest-auto-seed-graded 400) and 11,900 are checklistcenter-2026-09-05. Not one bare-address soccer row comes from a source that could be a rival product's checklist -- there is no rival product.

THE 09-05 INGEST LANDED AT THE BARE ADDRESS; THE 09-06 RE-INGEST LANDED AT THE COMPETITION ADDRESS. Both carry setKey='panini-prizm-fifa-world-cup-qatar' in the FIELD and setName 'panini prizm fifa world cup qatar soccer'; they differ only in the ID. 11,630 of the 11,900 have an EXACT 09-06 twin (same number, parallel, printRun, grade, auto flag) and the playerName agrees on all 11,630 of them -- zero disagreements. Those are duplicates and are RETIRED.

THE 270 WITHOUT A TWIN ARE RESLUGGED, NOT RETIRED. They are card numbers 1-90 in silver-prizm, blue-shimmer-prizm and gold-10-or-prizm -- three parallels the 09-06 re-ingest reproduced only from #91 up. All three parallels DO exist at the competition address (410 / 400 / 110 rows), so this is a coverage gap in the re-ingest, not a different product. A retire would delete 270 real checklist rows; a reslug carries them.

THE 1,395 SALES-DERIVED ROWS ARE RESLUGGED. Every one carries setName '2022 Panini Prizm FIFA World Cup Qatar Soccer' and 1,372 of the 1,395 sit on a card number the World Cup checklist lists. A reslug re-points that row's sales; a retire would hand 1,395 rows' sales to the rematch for no gain when the correct destination is known and free.
MEASURED: 0 of the 1,665 reslug destinations is occupied, and no destination is named twice in this list.

THIS LIST DOES NOT TOUCH THE 130,257 STRICT BASEBALL / BASKETBALL / FOOTBALL ROWS AT setKey='panini-prizm', cardYear=2022. Those flagships are real products with real checklists and are none of this list's business. The soccer selection is by sport AND address.
